name: Announcement Bar
description: One announcement bar at the top of every page: a short message, an optional link, four styles and an optional close button. Edited in the site settings, no third-party requests.

panels.title: Announcement bar
panels.description: One line shown at the top of every page on this site.

fields.name: message
fields.title: Message
fields.description: Leave it empty to show nothing.

fields.name: link-text
fields.title: Link text
fields.description: Optional, such as "Read more". Shown after the message.

fields.name: link-url
fields.title: Link address
fields.description: An https:// address or a path on this site such as /shop. Without link text the whole message becomes the link.

fields.name: colour
fields.title: Bar colour
fields.description: Used with the style "My own colour". The text turns dark or light by itself to stay readable.

fields.name: dismissible
fields.title: Visitors can close it
fields.description: Adds a close button. A closed bar stays closed for that visitor until you change the message.
